source.note: all positions in Blender space, cm (X forward, Y left, Z up), parts at their rest positions; planes and pivots from chaser_meshy_parts.report.json

method.components: connected components of triangles after merging vertices by position (1e-4 cm)
method.far_triangles: triangles outside the main (largest) component: distance of the centroid to the bbox of the main component and to its centroid
method.wrong_side: a triangle centroid (or vertex) inside the plane zone box on the side of the plane opposite to the part's main component by more than 0.05 cm; hip planes only count triangles on the pelvis side of the waist plane (as the cut did)
method.open_edges: triangle edges used by one triangle (merged positions)
method.joint_distance: vertex distance to the part's own pivot (its joint) and to the parent's pivot

exr.channel_layout: texel x=2*part quaternion xyzw, x=2*part+1 translation t cm; frame f = row f from the top of the file

pose_check.formula: line by line port of the Unreal Custom node: q renormalised, q=(-x,y,-z,w), tr=(x,-y,z), LocalPos=(x,-y,z) of the Blender vertex, new=LocalPos+offset, mirrored back; part index of each vertex read from the PartId UV (floor(uv*10)) and checked against the object
pose_check.keyed_path: meshy_bake_anim.py functions: run_pose, apply_pose, fit_ground on the parent hierarchy, vertices = matrix_world @ local
